title: A lighter Consegna page on mobile
subtitle: GASS 2.30.x — mockup design/mockups/consegna-mobile-compatta.html
context:
Request (2026-10-14), after looking at the 2.30 preview on a phone: the mobile Consegna page is too full. (1) Notebook photos, note and tolti/rimessi should live in a section of their own, as a modal. (2) Maybe the cassa summaries should leave the Consegna page and show only once the consegna is closed. (3) In the participant card, the saldo before today (credito/debito) should move under Importo saldato.

Today (mobile, `public/consegna.html`): header, cassa row (Trovato/Incassato/Pagato/In cassa) + tolti/rimessi lines + quote teatro, status box with Chiudi/Annulla, Quaderno block, Note, tolti/rimessi rows, then the add select and the list "Chi ha ritirato". The participant card (`buildParticipantCardHTML` in `public/js/shared/consegna-common.js`) is full-screen at ≤ 768px and shows "prima di oggi" as a pill in its header.

Mockup: `design/mockups/consegna-mobile-compatta.html` (sections G, H, I = decisions F1, F2, F3). Ships together with the 2.30.0 work not yet released.

glossary.definition: A full-screen panel over the page with a back arrow, like the participant card on mobile.

pages.title: A lighter Consegna page on mobile
pages.intro: Where cassa, notebook, note and tolti/rimessi live on the phone, and where the card shows the saldo before today.

decisions.title: Notebook, note and tolti/rimessi in a sheet of their own
decisions.why: On a phone the list of people starts about two screens down: the turnista scrolls past cassa, status, notebook, note and rows at every person. Moving them changes where people look for things they learned last week, so it is worth one decision.
decisions.proposal: On mobile the page shows one row **"Cassa e quaderno ›"** with a one-line summary ("In cassa 467 · quaderno 1 foto · rimessi +32,80"). It opens a **full-screen sheet** built like the participant card (back arrow, Salva): cassa summary (F2), quote teatro, Quaderno, Soldi tolti o rimessi in cassa, Note della giornata. The status with Chiudi/Annulla consegna moves to the bottom of the page, after the list. Desktop is unchanged (it has room).
decisions.learn_more: The sheet reuses the existing elements (`#quaderno-box`, `#uscite-edit`, `#noteGiornata`, `#uscite-errore`) moved into a container that gets the same full-screen CSS as `.participant-card-flow` at ≤ 768px, so saving, drafts and the close reminder keep working. "Fotografa prima" in the close dialog opens the sheet first. Leaving the sheet with unsaved changes asks like the card does ("Modifiche non salvate").

options.label: Full-screen sheet, opened by one row
pros: The list starts right under the header
Same gesture as the participant card
cons: One tap more to reach note and notebook

options.label: Collapsible block in the page (closed by default)
cons: Still pushes the list down when open
Two kinds of 'open' on one page

tasks.title: Move cassa, notebook, note and rows into a mobile sheet
tasks.do: `consegna.html`: wrap the cassa row, quote teatro, `#quaderno-box` and `#note-giornata-group` in `#giornata-sheet` with a header (back, title "Cassa e quaderno") and the Salva; add the summary row `#giornata-row` before the add select; move `#consegna-status-section` after the list. `consegna.js`: `openGiornata()` / `closeGiornata()` (unsaved check), summary text from cassa, quaderno count and `usciteVersi`. `style.css`: sheet full-screen at ≤ 768px like `.participant-card-flow`. `apriQuaderno` opens the sheet first on mobile.

Note, rows and photos save as before; drafts still restore
"Fotografa prima" opens the sheet and the camera

decisions.title: Where the cassa summary is while the consegna is open
decisions.why: Whoever counts the cash compares it with In cassa before closing. Hiding it while open removes a check the turnisti use; showing it on the page is what makes it full.
decisions.proposal: While open, the cassa summary (Trovato, Incassato, Pagato, tolti/rimessi, In cassa) is **inside the sheet**, and the page row shows only "In cassa 467". When the consegna is closed, the page shows the full cassa at the top, read-only, as today.

visual.alt: Mockup H: H1 summary in the sheet, H2 summary only when closed, and the closed consegna page
visual.caption: Mockup section H

decisions.learn_more: Your remark said "maybe only when closed": that is option H2. With H2 the only place to compare the counted cash before closing is the summary in the "Chiudi consegna" dialog (it already lists Lasciato in cassa). I read "riepiloghi" as the cassa row and its lines (tolti/rimessi, quote teatro); if you meant the list "Chi ha ritirato", say so with Change.

options.label: H1 · In the sheet while open, on the page when closed
pros: The cash check is still one tap away
cons: Not visible at a glance (only In cassa in the row)

options.label: H2 · Only when closed
cons: Counting before closing only via the close dialog

Closed consegna: full summary at the top of the page

decisions.title: "Prima di oggi" under Importo saldato in the card
decisions.why: The saldo before today is what turns conto and versato into credito/debito; shown as a pill in the header it is read apart from the numbers it explains.
decisions.proposal: Remove the pill from the card header; show a row **"Prima di oggi: debito −53,44 €"** (or credito, or "pari") right under Importo saldato, before "Debito saldato per intero" / Lascia credito.

decisions.title: Docs and videos after the layout change

decisions.proposal: Update the manuals and quick guide (mobile), and re-record the phone clips whose screens changed (consegna, uscite, chiudere), cut as today.
